title: A faster shared clock becomes a network
fact: Proof of History was conceived in 2017; Solana's genesis block launched Mainnet Beta on March 16, 2020.
interpretation: The original wager was that cheap, fast shared state could support applications at internet scale.

title: The first application boom
fact: The Solana Foundation reported rapid growth in DeFi, NFTs, validators, and projects during 2021; its historical counts do not include a reproducible methodology.
interpretation: Demand arrived quickly, making precise definitions of users, projects, and capital essential.

title: Ambition meets reliability
fact: Solana launched payment and mobile experiments while official incident reports documented consensus-impacting network halts.
interpretation: Throughput means little without dependable execution, so reliability belongs beside adoption.

title: Builders carry the recovery
fact: The Foundation highlighted Helium's migration, state compression, Saga, DeFi recovery, and major commerce and infrastructure integrations.
interpretation: The recovery case rests on retained builders and widening utility, not token price alone.

title: Trading broadens into distribution
fact: Foundation and developer reports documented growth across stablecoins, payments, mobile, DePIN, institutions, and new developers.
interpretation: Solana began looking less like one trading venue and more like a general financial and consumer platform.

title: Reliability and application economics
fact: A Foundation network report cited nearly 16 months of uptime, multiple validator clients, substantial application revenue, and a voting-power Nakamoto coefficient of 20.
interpretation: The next test became resilience: diverse software, distributed stake, and sustainable operators.

title: Financial rails move to the foreground
fact: Foundation ecosystem reports highlighted expanding stablecoin settlement and tokenized real-world assets; live values require their underlying datasets.
interpretation: The thesis now is convergence: crypto-native markets meeting payments, tokenized assets, and institutional distribution.
